images.caption: Figure 2:Source video frames and aligned structural conditions.(a) Public datasets pair RGB frames with Magpie white-box geometry, CARLA depth, OmniWorld-Game depth, and Virtual KITTI 2 semantic layouts[67,11,76,3]. (b) Self-collected GTA V and Cyberpunk 2077 examples pair each RGB source frame with matched coarse and fine proxies of the same event, where coarse proxies place canonical root-driven bodies and fine proxies track articulated limbs.

Figure 3:Capture and multi-granularity proxy construction pipeline.Synchronized gameplay capture and 3D scene reconstruction yield aligned appearance targets, geometry, entity dynamics, metadata, and text annotations. From a shared scene state, the pipeline renders matched coarse and fine structural proxies for each event.

Figure 8:Qualitative comparison of causal streaming renderers on held-out rollouts.Each column shows one test sequence at a matched late-rollout timestamp (11 s to 18 s). The top shaded rows display the 0 s appearance reference and the synchronized input proxy, followed by frames from other works and Invoker-Render (outlined at bottom), which maintains both structural fidelity and reference appearance at the shown late-rollout timestamps.

Figure 11:Long-horizon causal rendering on two racing sequences.Each case shows six matched timestamps, read from left to right. Rows contain the
input proxy, two prior works (A and B), and Invoker-Render. The upper and lower cases extend
to 298 s and 299 s, respectively, showing vehicle appearance and trajectory
adherence over approximately five minutes.
